description: This file defines the main class `ECUEditor` used for editing ECU (Engine Control Unit) configurations within the RomRaider project. It manages loading, displaying, and interacting with ROM images, handles UI components such as menus, toolbars, and image trees, and contains workers for asynchronous operations like opening and closing images. It also includes related worker classes for background processing and event handling.

classes.name: ECUEditor
classes.description: Main class for managing the ECU editing UI, handling ROM image loading/unloading, UI components, and background workers.

classes.name: LaunchLoggerWorker
classes.description: Background worker to handle launching the ECU logger asynchronously.

classes.name: SetUserLevelWorker
classes.description: Background worker to update the display based on user privilege level.

classes.name: CloseImageWorker
classes.description: Background worker to close and remove a loaded ROM image from the editor.

classes.name: OpenImageWorker
classes.description: Background worker to open a ROM image, parse its data, and load it into the editor asynchronously.

methods.name: initializeEditorUI
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the menu bar, toolbars, and UI layout components.

methods.name: checkDefinitions
methods.description: Checks for configured ECU definition files and prompts user if none are configured.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Saves settings and performs cleanup when exiting.

methods.name: addRom
methods.description: Adds a ROM object to the image tree, updates the UI, and manages selection.

methods.name: displayTable
methods.description: Displays a table frame in the editor, opening it if not already displayed.

methods.name: removeDisplayTable
methods.description: Removes a table frame from display and updates UI.

methods.name: closeImage
methods.description: Closes the currently selected ROM image asynchronously.

methods.name: getLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Returns the last ROM that was selected.

methods.name: setLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Sets the reference to the last selected ROM.

methods.name: openImage
methods.description: Loads a ROM image file into the editor asynchronously.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a byte array.
